title: Alpharetta Women's Half Marathon & 5K
dateNote: Early November 2026 (check official site for race day)
desc: The annual women's half marathon and 5K through Alpharetta, finishing at Avalon.

title: Season of Celebration Tree Lighting
dateNote: Late November 2026 (date announced by the city)
desc: Downtown Alpharetta kicks off the holidays with its annual tree lighting, lighting up the city with some 10,000 bulbs, followed by holiday activities on the Town Green through December.

title: Lighting of Avalon & Avalon on Ice
dateNote: Late November 2026; the ice rink runs to about mid-January
desc: Avalon's tree lighting with music, free family activities and Santa, opening the Avalon on Ice skating rink for the season.

title: Menorah Lighting at Avalon
desc: Avalon's annual community menorah lighting during Hanukkah.

title: Noon Year's Eve at The Hotel at Avalon
desc: A family-friendly early New Year's party with a balloon drop at noon, so the kids can celebrate without the midnight bedtime.

title: Alpharetta Farmers Market (2027 season)
desc: Local growers, bakers, makers and artisans on the Town Green every Saturday morning, 8:30 a.m. to 12:30 p.m., April through November.

title: Alpharetta Food Truck Alley (2027 season)
dateNote: 4th Thursday of the month, April through October, 5 to 9 p.m.
desc: Ten or more food trucks plus live music one Thursday evening a month. Seating is limited, so bring a chair or blanket; pets are not permitted.

title: Celebrate Freedom Rodeo
desc: A two-day western rodeo at the Wills Park Equestrian Center.

title: Taste of Alpharetta
desc: An evening of samples from 60+ local restaurants with cooking demos and entertainment. Admission is free; food tickets are sold on site.

title: Alpharetta Arts Streetfest
desc: An outdoor art festival with 100+ artists at The Grove at Wills Park.

title: Alpharetta Brew Moon Fest
desc: Downtown Alpharetta's annual evening beer festival.

title: 4th of July Celebration at Wills Park
desc: Alpharetta's annual Independence Day picnic at Wills Park, with fireworks at dusk.

title: Wire & Wood Alpharetta Songwriters Festival
desc: A free festival with 30+ songwriters performing on six outdoor stages across downtown.
